verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no shipped Bevy editor to extend, and a community member explicitly wishes for one (bevy-comm-6), so the editor-extension core of the story is unevidenced. Bevy does let you manipulate scenes programmatically and build custom tools in code: its plugin architecture (bevy-gh-1), the Scene system to create, save and load ECS worlds (bevy-docs-8), and the first-party Bevy Remote Protocol, on which community tooling like bevy_brp is built (bevy-probe-rt-2). missing for 10: an actual editor to extend, an editor scripting/plugin API, documented editor-tool workflows, and hands-on corroboration of custom editor tooling.
